# Fit on a Sphere

![Fit on a Sphere function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/fitting/10-fitting_on_sphere.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Fits a 3D sphere by the documented algebraic squared-distance objective; center is one DBL vector of length3 and radius is DBL. Coplanar or otherwise nonidentifiable observations are diagnosed; no fabricated residue output. Variants: default.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Fit on a Sphere**

Ajuste une sphère3D ; centre = un vecteur DBL de trois composantes, rayon DBL. Les nuages non identifiables sont diagnostiqués. Variantes : default.

</details>
